summary: DAEDALUS/AEGIS independently verified the Adaptive Brain custom-agent ingress authenticates the immutable event Git blob and source allowlist, but does not independently verify event evidence/paths or bind a source_commit/report/experiment digest before projecting agent and nested subsystem findings. Event authenticity is verified; scientific evidence authenticity remains caller-asserted.
surface: ICARUS Adaptive Brain remote custom-agent ingress / GitHub-native v3 provenance boundary

evidence.verified_controls: BrainRemoteSync recomputes Git blob SHA, requires execution_authorized=false, allowlists DAEDALUS_AUTOMATION, enforces icarus-mcp-event-v1 and producer required envelope fields.
evidence.falsification: The producer required_fields omit source_commit/artifact digest fields. brain_sync.py copies evidence strings/mappings into Brain evidence and projects nested daedalus/aegis findings without dereferencing or hashing claimed evidence paths/artifacts.

daedalus.finding: Git-blob/source admission is fail-closed, but scientific evidence referenced by a custom-agent event is not cryptographically bound or independently revalidated before Brain projection.

aegis.finding: A source-allowlisted DAEDALUS_AUTOMATION event can carry fabricated evidence/path claims or nested subsystem findings inside an authentic Git blob; current ingress verifies the container, not the claimed scientific artifacts.
